home.title: Home
home.lead: SEDRA learning has short lessons with videos, text and simple practice. You choose the pace.
home.heroAlt: Two young adults learn together at a table with a tablet.
home.lifeSkillsBody: Healthy Communication: share how you feel and try Stop, Think, Do.
home.hospitalityBody: Introduction to Hospitality: help people feel welcome, safe and comfortable.
home.accessHeading: Learn in the way that works for you
home.accessCaptions: Captions and text for every video
home.accessButtons: Buttons instead of gestures. No time limits.
home.accessNote: You can change these choices at any time after you sign in.
home.headline: Learn everyday skills. Practise hospitality.
home.howLead: One clear task at a time. No timers.
home.step1Body: A short video, or read the same lesson as text.
home.step2Body: No time limit. Try again as often as you like.
home.step3Body: An optional activity. Do it now, later or with help.
home.programmesLead: Pick one to start. You can switch at any time.

welcome.heading: Welcome to SEDRA learning
welcome.lead: Sign in to continue. This is a demo, so no real account is used.
welcome.helpBody: Ask your supporter or the SEDRA team. You can take your time. In this demo, you can also choose a profile below.
welcome.pickLead: Pick who you want to be. All profiles are fictional.

prefs.heading: How would you like to learn?
prefs.lead: Every choice can be changed later; no medical details required.
prefs.viewSimplifiedHint: Fewer cards. Main actions and help stay.
prefs.motionOff: Allow gentle movement (your device setting still wins)
prefs.readAloudHint: Shows a button to hear some text read aloud. You start and stop it. It does not replace your screen reader.
prefs.previewText: Short lessons. Clear steps. Your own pace.
prefs.saveNote: You can change these at any time.

dashboard.allDone: You finished all units. You can replay any unit when you are ready.
dashboard.noSession: No live session is planned right now.
dashboard.resourcesBody: Read the Stop Think Do guide and lesson summaries.
dashboard.helpBody: Read tips or ask for support.

programme.notFound: We could not find this programme.
programme.timeNote: Each unit has a short video plus practice; total time varies.
programme.videoPending: Video being prepared. Read the lesson now.
programme.extraVideoHint: Optional. Not needed to finish the course.
programme.switchNote: Your progress is kept when you switch.
programme.pathLead: Go in order or choose any unit. You can replay every unit.

sessions.heading: Live sessions
sessions.lead: Join a live session with your group, or look at recordings later. Times are shown in UAE time.
sessions.joinToast: Demo: no live meeting is opened.
sessions.bookingBody: SEDRA shares the meeting link before the session. In this demo, no link is opened.
sessions.noUpcoming: No upcoming sessions for this programme.
sessions.noRecordings: No recordings for this programme yet.
sessions.pendingBody: The recording is not ready yet. It will have captions and a transcript.
sessions.noPenalty: Missing a session is okay. Recordings are separate from your course progress.
sessions.heroAlt: A group of young people sit together and share picture cards.
sessions.cancelledBody: This session is cancelled. There is nothing to join.

resources.heading: Resources
resources.lead: Read the Stop Think Do guide. No PDF is required to finish a lesson.
resources.guideIntro: When you feel a big feeling, these steps can help.
resources.stopBody: Take a break before you act. If you feel mad, sad or confused, pause in a way that helps you.
resources.thinkBody: Ask yourself: What happened? Why am I upset? What can I do to fix it?
resources.doBody: Pick the best thing to do. Try to solve the problem in a kind and safe way.
resources.calmIntro: Choose what helps you. None of these is required.
resources.t2: Moving your body in a comfortable way
resources.b2: Can improve mood and lower stress
resources.b3: Helps you notice how you feel
resources.b4: Helps with self-control and pauses strong feelings
resources.why2: Solve problems in a good way
resources.why4: Feel proud of the choices you make
resources.playbookIntro: A small reminder for when you need it.
resources.notChosen: Not chosen yet. Choose it in unit 8.
resources.extHeading: Video shared by SEDRA project team
resources.extNote: This video is optional. You do not need it to finish a lesson.
resources.extFrameTitle: Video shared by SEDRA project team (YouTube)
resources.searchHint: Type a word, for example: feeling or welcome.
resources.noResults: No summaries match. Try another word.
resources.planIntro: One welcoming action to try today. Plan it in unit 8.

achievements.heading: My achievements
achievements.lead: Your personal milestones. Learn at your own pace.
achievements.badgesLead: Four optional milestones in Healthy Communication.
achievements.hospitalityDone: You practised a new skill. Continue when you are ready.
achievements.hospitalityNotYet: Finish all 8 units to see your acknowledgement.
achievements.disclaimer: These milestones are personal. They are not a qualification, certificate or proof of readiness for work.
achievements.journeyLead: Units you finished, in course order.
achievements.journeyEmpty: Your journey starts with your first unit.

help.heading: Help
help.lead: You can get help at any time. Take your time.
help.tip1: Use Home, Learn, Sessions and Help at the bottom of the screen on a phone, or at the top on a computer.
help.tip2: Continue learning on Home opens your next step.
help.tip3: Each unit has a video or text. You can read instead of watching.
help.tip4: There is no time limit. You can try again as many times as you like.
help.tip5: Use Tab and Enter on a keyboard. Skip to main content is the first button.
help.tip6: Change language, text size and contrast in Preferences.
help.formLead: Your request is saved in this demo only. No message is sent.
help.messageHint: You can skip this. Choosing a topic is enough. A supporter can type for you.
help.errorTopic: Choose what you need help with.
help.sent: Your request is saved in this demo only. No message was sent.
help.supporterAlt: A learner uses a tablet while a supporter sits beside them.
help.supporter1: A supporter can sit with you, read with you or help you use the buttons.
help.supporter2: You choose when to ask for help. You can practise alone or with someone.

auth.panelBody: Short lessons, simple practice and support when you need it.

invite.heading: Accept your invitation
invite.enrolNote: SEDRA chose these programmes for you.
invite.passwordHint: Use at least 8 letters or numbers.

invite.errorShort: Use at least 8 letters or numbers.

invite.notFoundTitle: We could not find this invitation
invite.notFoundBody: The link may be old or not complete. You can sign in below, or ask SEDRA for a new link.
invite.disclosureBody: SEDRA sends you an invitation link by email. Open the link to create your account. This is a demo, so no emails are sent: an admin can open an invitation link from Admin, then Learners.
